name: 02653 · Orleans, MA
findings: ZIP 02653 (Orleans) has 37 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02653 (Orleans) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 02653 (Orleans) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.
